author: user3620403769810
caption: #💗 🌙🌸 “Powerful girl outfit” to get through a bad day, right? 😌✨ So even when you’re in a bad mood you still look elegant, classy, and make people respect you — the key: clean look, neutral colors, and neat styling. A powerful outfit isn’t the flashiest one, but the one with the calmest aura. 3 Bad-Day-Proof Powerful Girl Outfit Formulas 1. Elegant Smart Casual For campus, work, or hanging out — classy but still giving expensive vibes Top: Oversized neat white shirt / satin blouse in cream, black, or navy Bottom: High-waist fabric pants or midi pencil skirt in neutral colors Shoes: Low heels, loafers, or clean white sneakers Extra: Simple watch + small structured bag Vibes: Calm, elegant, and gives off “don’t mess with her.” ✨ 2. Monochrome Clean Girl Simple but the aura is super strong Top: Fitted black tee / plain turtleneck Bottom: Wide-leg pants or clean black skirt Outer: Oversized blazer or premium knit cardigan Shoes: Boots or full white/full black sneakers Vibes: Cold, mysterious, classy without overdoing it. 🖤 3. Soft Old Money Look Feminine but still powerful Top: Knit polo / linen shirt in olive, mocha, beige, soft brown Bottom: Long satin skirt or straight-cut cream pants Shoes: Loafers, kitten heels, or premium white sneakers Extra: Simple small necklace + sleek, silky hair Vibes: Mature, expensive, and elegant old money energy. 🤍 Keys to a Powerful Girl on Bad Days: Fit is still number one An outfit that fits your body instantly boosts your aura. Neutral colors are more powerful Black, white, navy, olive, cream = auto classy. Hair & shoes must be neat Sometimes power comes from the smallest details. Makeup shouldn’t be too busy Soft makeup + nude/brick-red lipstick is more elegant. Less but expensive look Simple but looks expensive > too many accessories. 👌 #outfit_cowok_berwarna #outfit_cowok_berwarna #outfit_cowok_berwarna #outfit_cowok_berwarna

author: petitelife_incolors
caption: Dos & Don’ts with midi skirts this fall. 💡 The idea is to create a harmonious look without breaking proportions Boots: pick knee high boots or any height that "hides" behind the skirt for a continuous line and more elongating effect. Ankle cut boots + matching (more opaque) tights to the skirt or boots can also work  Blazers/Jackets/Sweaters: cropped or full length to a skirt are the better options. Shorter ones are the game changer with their 1/3 & 2/3 bonus. You can belt a longer jacket to achieve the same effect.  Heels: pointy toe flats, kitten heels will draw they eye down without "making any stops" (breaking the outfit)Strappy heels work if the tights are of the same color  Outwear: Sitting at the waist or same length as the skirt to create a harmonious look Tops: depending on the skirt, balance off the bottom with the right top -   if a skirt is fuller, think more fitted tops -   if a skirt is slimmer, more volume on top General tips: -  mix different fabrics/prints/ textures for a more interesting look -  accessorize - little details make a big difference in an outfit -  tuck your top in to define a waistline -  use a belt if it works in your outfit #dosanddonts #midiskirt #fashiontutorial #fashionhelp #fashion101

author: vee.valery
caption: 🎀 How to Style: Cute Kawaii Preppy 1. The Outfit A playful kawaii-preppy look built around soft colors, a cute graphic knit and feminine details. 2. What I’m wearing A cream sweater with a colorful lion graphic and pink gingham details, a black pleated mini skirt, white frilly knee-high socks with pink bows, and classic black Mary Janes. 3. How the look comes together The cream and pink create a soft base, while the black skirt and Mary Janes add contrast. The bows, gingham cuffs and playful graphic make the look feel coordinated without being too formal. 4. Styling tip Pick one main color accent and repeat it in small details. Here, the pink appears in the collar, cuffs and sock bows, tying the whole outfit together. 5. Easy formula Cute graphic sweater + pleated skirt + frilly socks + matching bows + Mary Janes = kawaii-preppy. Would you wear this look exactly as it is, or add your own twist? 🎀 #HowToStyle #KawaiiStyle #PreppyStyle #CuteOutfit #OutfitInspo
